sources.title: Olive mature bearing trees fertilizer schedule

recommendations.applicationTiming: P2O5+K2O+FYM: January trench. N: 1/3 mid-Feb, 1/3 mid-Apr, 1/3 Jul/Aug. Perennial: kg/ha/YEAR.
recommendations.applicationMethod: Bearing kinnow (6-8 yr trees, 277 trees/ha): 900-1000 g N + 500 g P2O5 + 500 g K2O per tree/year + 40-50 kg FYM/tree. P2O5/K2O oxide forms confirmed (commercial fertilizer basis: DAP 46% P2O5, MOP 60% K2O). N split in thirds: 1/3 mid-Feb (pre-bloom), 1/3 mid-Apr (fruit set), 1/3 Jul/Aug (monsoon). P2O5+K2O+FYM in January trench under canopy before flowering.
Punjab citrus cluster report: 990:500:500 g/tree/yr. Cross-confirms AARI Sargodha/UAF schedule. P2O5/K2O oxide forms confirmed.

CCRI Nagpur April advisory for juvenile trees — 4-year rate shown: 432 g urea + 628 g SSP/tree (no K stated in advisory; K2O null, not zero). Rates scale by tree age (1-yr base rate doubled/tripled/quadrupled for 2/3/4-yr trees). NON-BEARING ONLY — must never be used as a bearing-tree substitute; the verified bearing record (C-IN-1) is the primary.

Bearing Nagpur mandarin (6–7 yr): 1.78 kg urea + 1.26 kg SSP + 0.18 kg MOP/tree/yr + 25 kg FYM before monsoon. Density 277.78 trees/ha (6×6 m). Oxides EXPLICIT via fertilizer grades. CONFLICT NOTE: a second CCRI-linked schedule (Srivastava et al. 2021) uses 1.30 kg urea/tree (N 166.1) with identical P/K — kept as the under-review alternative C-IN-2; the 1.78 kg figure stays primary as the quoted official PoP. Caveat: PoP quoted from a peer-reviewed adoption study; primary CCRI PoP page not located.

recommendations.applicationTiming: Split across Ambia/Mrig bahar. Perennial: kg/ha/YEAR.
recommendations.applicationMethod: Srivastava et al. (CCRI Nagpur) 2021 cultivar schedule: 1300 g urea + 1260 g SSP + 180 g MOP/tree/yr (Ambia/Mrig bahar splits). UREA CONFLICT with the primary C-IN-1 record (1.30 kg vs 1.78 kg urea/tree; P/K identical) — NOT auto-resolved. Kept as the under-review alternative until reconciled. P2O5/K2O oxide forms confirmed (CCRI Nagpur/TNAU use commercial fertilizer basis).

TNAU Agritech: Palani Hills bearing mandarin (6th year onwards): 600:200:400 g/tree/yr + 30 kg FYM, applied June + October. Density 277.78 trees/ha (6×6 m). OXIDE AMBIGUITY: TNAU labels 'N/P/K' without stating P2O5/K2O — recorded per Indian convention but not explicit. Under review.

TNAU Agritech: Shervaroyan hills bearing mandarin (above 6 years): 700:375:600 g/tree/yr + 1 kg VAM/tree. Same oxide ambiguity as the Palani record. HILL-MANDARIN SPECIFIC — not transferable to plains. Under review.

ICAR-NRCG official extension technology: conventional soil-application reference dose for Thompson Seedless on Dogridge rootstock — 660 kg N : 880 kg P2O5 : 660 kg K2O per ha per full double-pruning season (foundation + fruit pruning). Oxides EXPLICIT in source. (Fertigation at 40% of this gave equivalent yield — see the derived annual fertigation record G-IN-12.) Caveat: citation via 1library mirror of the NRCG compendium; original nrcgrapes.in page not located.

DERIVED ANNUAL TOTAL — arithmetic sum of the 10 published NRCG fertigation stage rows (NRCG + MANAGE 2023 eBook) for the double-pruning system. Use INSTEAD OF stage rows for a single annual figure; never sum with them (stage rows G-IN-2…11 deliberately NOT populated — double-count risk). Independently corroborated by a 2026 peer-reviewed review. Note: the '40% of conventional' framing holds for N and K2O (0.4×660=264) but NOT for P2O5 (0.4×880=352 vs 177.5) — table used as-is, not rescaled.

recommendations.applicationTiming: FYM+P+50%K: January post-pruning. N: 50% Mar (bud-break), 25% Apr (berry-set), 25%+50%K May/Jun (veraison). Perennial: kg/ha/YEAR.
recommendations.applicationMethod: Table grapes (1500-1600 vines/ha, 3x2m): FYM 15-20 kg/vine + all P2O5 + 50% K2O in January trench after pruning. N splits: 50% at spring bud-break (Mar), 25% at berry-set (Apr), 25% + 50% K2O at veraison (May/Jun) for sweetness/quality. K2O as Sulphate of Potash. Source: BARI Chakwal (Viticulture), NARC Islamabad.

recommendations.applicationTiming: FYM+P+half K+B: January. N: 50% early Feb, 50%+50%K late Apr. Perennial: kg/ha/YEAR.
recommendations.applicationMethod: Mature bearing olive (9+ yr, 270 trees/ha, 6x6m): FYM 35-40 kg/tree + all P2O5 + half K2O + Boron in January trench under canopy drip-line. N: 50% early Feb (3 weeks before flowering) + 50% + 50% K2O late Apr (after fruit set). Source: BARI Chakwal (Olive Research Centre), PARC National Olive Development Project.
